payload.claim: The verbatim line template in Problem item 1, f"{spec id:<10} over budget  needs {budget_usd:.3f}, {left:.3f} left", names its second field `budget_usd`, which is also the name of _drive's own total-budget parameter (the whole batch's ceiling). The surrounding prose ('that candidate's budget') makes clear it means the candidate's own spec.budget_usd, so this is resolvable from context, but the shared name invites a cell to print the wrong value.
